answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital lockup. Like a cedar rooted firmly in soil, this protocol ensures identity integrity by attaching a financial cost to network participation. Any attempt to vine through the network with malicious nodes requires prohibitive collateral. Even if an attacker attempts to whisper false data across the consensus layer, the economic penalty of slashing renders such subversion unprofitable and technically infeasible.
